care: One of a kind original, painted entirely by hand with acrylic on cotton canvas. Signed by the artist with a Certificate of Authenticity. Available by commission in custom sizes and colors.

list.d: A celebration of Jewish strength, continuity, and the enduring spirit of Am Yisrael Chai. The Tree of Life represents deep roots, connection, and the ability to continue growing through every generation.
A reflection on where we come from and what keeps us grounded. The roots represent family, heritage, and identity, while the branches express growth, renewal, and the journey forward.

Created in the shadow of October 7 and the tragedy at the Nova festival, this work is about remembrance, resilience, and choosing life. The dancer continues to move as a symbol of freedom, hope, and the determination to dance again.

The Hamsa is a timeless symbol of protection, blessing, and strength. Reimagined through movement, texture, and color, this work connects an ancient Jewish symbol with a contemporary message of hope and protection.

A reflection of identity, belonging, and the enduring connection between the Jewish people and the land of Israel. This work carries a message of memory, resilience, and the strength of a connection that continues across generations.

A symbol of peace, freedom, and the hope for a brighter future. The dove represents our desire for harmony, healing, and a world where compassion and understanding are stronger than division. This work carries a message of hope and the belief that peace is always worth striving for.
The Western Wall is a place where generations have come to pray, remember, and feel connected. This work captures a moment of faith and reflection at one of the most sacred places in Jewish life.
A tribute to the bond between Israel and the United States. The 2 flags come together as a symbol of friendship, solidarity, shared values, and the strength that comes from standing together.
The Menorah has carried Jewish light through generations. This work represents faith, continuity, and the belief that even in moments of darkness, a small light can guide us forward.

The Torah represents faith, wisdom, tradition, and the spiritual foundation carried from generation to generation. This work honors the sacred words that have guided the Jewish people throughout history and continue to bring meaning and light into our lives.

A reflection on the connection Jewish people carry with Israel across distance and generations. The work speaks to belonging, identity, memory, and the feeling that Israel remains part of us wherever we may be.
A celebration of freedom, transformation, and the courage to move beyond limitations. The butterfly represents change, movement, and the beauty that can emerge when we allow ourselves to grow.

The Lion of Judah is a powerful symbol of courage, leadership, Jewish identity, and strength. This work speaks to resilience, heritage, and the determination to stand proudly for who we are and what we believe in.
